edition.authority: Approved by the Vicars Apostolic of England, 21 September 1848
edition.notes: The title page reads `NEWLY ARRANGED AND IN GREAT MEASURE TRANSLATED BY THE VERY REV. F. C. HUSENBETH. NEW EDITION IMPROVED. WITH THE APPROBATION OF ALL THE Rt. Rev. the Vicars Apostolic of England.` The approbation leaf is dated 21 September 1848 and the editor's preface London, January 1847; the imprint of this printing is 1853. The Sunday numbering after Pentecost agrees with the 1962 Missale Romanum, but the running head at the top of a page names the Sunday whose formulary begins lower on that page, so the running head above the tail of the preceding Mass is one Sunday ahead of the text beneath it. Read the sectional heading, not the running head.

work.author: Frederick Charles Husenbeth
work.description: An English lay hand missal edited and in great measure newly translated by Provost F. C. Husenbeth for the English Catholic vicariates, printing the Masses of the Roman Missal with the proper Masses of the English saints in place. Its English of the orations is independent of the anonymous translation used in the Philadelphia Cummiskey missals, so the two are separate English witnesses to the same Latin formularies. It heads the Collect `Prayer` throughout. Like every pre-1955 hand missal its Holy Week, octaves, vigils, and seasonal second and third orations reflect the discipline in force before the 1955 and 1960 reforms.
work.title: The Missal for the use of the laity, with the Masses for all days throughout the year, according to the Roman Missal
